3.t: The Japanese Amusement Machine Manufacturers Association (JAMMA) has introduced a new standard in video game PCC.B’s. It was decided that all new products from any JAMMA member will use the same pin print-out on the edge connector. The edge connector will have 56 pin outs, 28 per side.
Konami Inc. will offer a 56 to 36 pin adaptor P.C.B. available through your distributor. This new adaptor PC.B. will enable the new 56 pin out to adapt to Konami’s old standard 36 pin out.
